title: 810. Largest Triangle Area

examples.explanation: The triangle (0,0),(0,2),(2,0) has area 2, which is the largest achievable.
The only triangle uses the three points and covers half a unit square.
All points lie on one line, so every triangle is flat.

hints: This is a portable adaptation: return the area as a finite, double-parseable decimal string.
Try every triple of points and keep the largest shoelace value: area = |x1(y2-y3)+x2(y3-y1)+x3(y1-y2)| / 2.
Three points on one line give zero area and can be ignored.
